name: TangleClaw eBay Seller
description: OpenClaw plugin for eBay seller automation — connect your own eBay seller account via authorization_code OAuth, read inventory/offers/orders/business-policies, and draft + publish listings behind a two-step approval gate. Direct REST against the eBay Sell APIs; the seller user token is stored locally and auto-refreshed. Hard-gated writes protect anything that touches live listings or money.

credentialsPath.description: Path to the eBay seller app credentials JSON. Required keys: client_id, cert_id, ru_name, redirect_url, environment ('sandbox' or 'production').

userTokenPath.description: Path where the seller's OAuth user token (access + refresh) is read + written. Auto-managed by the plugin; never hand-edited.

opsLogPath.description: Append-only operations log. One JSON object per write attempt (ts, tool_name, user_approved_at, request_summary, response_status, ebay_request_id).

defaultMarketplaceId.description: Marketplace used when a tool doesn't specify one (e.g., EBAY_US, EBAY_GB, EBAY_DE).

autoApprove.description: When true, collapses the two-step hard-gate (pending_approval → confirm_pending) into immediate execution, logged with user_approved_at='auto'. Leave false for interactive operation; enable only in trusted automation contexts.

pendingApprovalTtlMs.description: How long a hard-gate pending-approval token stays redeemable, in milliseconds. Default 900000 (15 min).

httpTimeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds (applies to every eBay REST call + the token endpoint). Default 30000 (30s).

tokenRefreshSafetyWindowMs.description: How many milliseconds before user-token expiry to proactively refresh. Default 60000 (60s).
